declared_configuration.composition: >=5 repetitions feed median-of-medians and min-of-medians for MIN and p50; p99 is computed once on the POOLED sample (ADR-0022, accepted)

rbac.note: A DECLARED CONFIGURATION, like the tier. Full access was chosen because it is the grant a customer admin role would carry; a read-only role would measure the same endpoints under a different permission cache shape.

endpoints.note: EM-2; 401 is the expected rejection, not a void. Bound by DEFAULT_ANONYMOUS_LIMIT (10, 3600) per source IP, so n<10,000 -- ADR-0022 rule 2.
endpoints.p99_note: withheld: pooled n=10 is below the 10000 sample floor (ADR-0022 Rule 2). A tail quantile read off a sample this size is a number with no estimate behind it. The p50 and p95 above did resolve and are the ones to quote.

pacing.note: Pacing is how the run RESPECTS the production limit. 4.5 voids a run in which a control was in force at a load-producing value; pacing is the opposite of raising one. Every window named by the endpoint is enforced at once, because no single rate respects (5, 60) and (10, 3600) together -- measured, both ways, in two runs.

endpoints.note: EM-5. TWO controls bind this endpoint and only the tighter one paces it. A login carries no access token, so the limiter keys it anonymous on the client IP, and its own path carries a per-path anonymous key: measured on perf-local, requests 0-9 answer 200 and request 10 answers 429, with gcra:rate_limit:anonymous:ip:127.0.0.1:account_login AND gcra:rate_limit:user:127.0.0.1:budget:auth both present. Which one binds depends on the RATE, and the two runs disagree in a way that is the finding: paced at 5/60 the AUTH leg always refills and the ANONYMOUS one runs out at request 10; paced at 10/3600 a burst spends the AUTH leg first and requests 6-10 are refused with the auth body 'Too many auth attempts' (/tmp/s4_anon.json, 5x200 then 5x429). So both are named and the tighter is chosen per run.

endpoints.note: EM-6. Logout has no budget leg of its own, but it is charged two others. Measured on perf-local with a paced probe (l8_probe_which_limiter_logout.py, 16 requests at 5 per 60 s from a purged start): requests 0-10 answer 200 and request 11 answers 429 with security:violations:127.0.0.1 appearing at that request, while gcra:rate_limit:anonymous:ip:127.0.0.1:account_logout sits in the key set with a TTL near 3600 whose stored value advances by exactly 360000 ms per request -- the GCRA 'when you may next act' stamp. Eleven successes is 10 anonymous per-path + 1, and the auth leg refilled throughout (TTL 72). ADR-0022 rule 2.

topology.http_server: uvicorn, started with no --loop and no --http so both resolve by auto-selection, which is the configuration Dockerfile's CMD ships
topology.seeding: IN-PROCESS over ASGITransport. Seeding is harness setup, not measured work; only the phases above go over the socket.
